name: Arm-parked knee 4R: J4 torsion spring parks the knee hub on arm skin; J2 fold-margin stops
lens: round4:honest 4-DOF comparison - what a 4th joint buys at the best seats, and what it costs in complexity
family: spherical 4R, spare set by a spring and stops (all axes through GH)
verdict: screened at O20 everywhere (user rule): best W3n 19.32 fast (near-touch 21.60), FROZEN on Bench(110,360) exact 25.05 = score 90.9 (near-touch 29.29 = 89.3; reach 0.772, overhead reach 0.29); stops at 11.7 deg from the J2 fold (the optimum: at 5 deg the same shape is 62.11 frozen). Beats the pin-knee 3R on the same protocol (28.21 / near 33.77) by ~3 / ~4.5 points, not the ideation's ~12 (that came from slim O15 hubs, now ruled out); price: complexity 32.25 (4 active) or 13.25 (J4 a sprung sensed pin) vs 19.5, and a 40-83 N.mm spring torque felt on 26-38 % of poses. Not the golden solution (complexity ~0); converged (gate passed in all 16 CMA streams).
limiter: (1) overhead: abduction overhead (plane 0-30, elev 150, axial 0) buries hub 2 + links 1/2 5-6 mm under the acromion skin bulge, and the knee window runs out (fold) at plane 90-120, elev 150-165 - overhead reach 0/12 fast, 0.29 frozen; an overhead-weighted CMA (4 streams) found at most 2/12 at +2.3 near points; (2) the 4th hub on the deltoid: hub 4 in band 0.51 (F 77) and link 3 0.32 - the spare's own metal is the worst-banded part; (3) the centred spring's two feasible arcs: the policy takes the low-energy arc, the physical knee stays on its arc (2 snap events in the preview loop, across->rest at elev 39 and behind->rest at elev 16) - workspace poses may be optimistic where history puts the knee on the other arc.
note: gate (claim stream W3n, near-touch objective): gain 0.87 over the 2nd half, 0.27 over the last third, top-5 spread 0.03 score points -> converged; every one of the 16 streams passes (sigma collapsed). Measured at margin 5 AND 10: W3n m10 24.94 / near 30.25, m5 62.11 / near 66.84 (the stop is a design variable here; 9-12 deg is its optimum, 5 is only the lower bound). O20 rebase of the ideation seats: 30.84 / 38.90 fast (m10 / m5), 33.91 / 44.24 frozen (ideation O15: 19.18 / 22.36). Spring sizing by virtual work through the self-motion Jacobian: hold needed max 18 / 29 N.mm (tau_f 3 / 6 N.mm per joint) -> preload 40 N.mm, 19 N.mm/rad; hub 4 skin-checked at r 12 for the coil. J4 locked: 82.18 fast at W3n (spare worth ~60 fast points at its seats). Overhead-weighted CMA (4 streams, 4196 tries): best O2n frozen 26.65 / near 31.99 with overhead reach 0.39 (W3n 0.29). || VERIFIED 2026-10-16 (independent verifier docs/concepts/verify/arm-parked-knee-4r.py, farm, Bench(110,360) exact, shape frozen from the Bench(60,160) fast fit, K6 1 mm radial): the model's 25.05 reproduced to the digit; corrected v_gap 26.71 (score 90.29; reach 0.7694, follow 0.9545, ib14 0.7989, ib10 0.3919, contact 0.0354) = + top faces of every member (6 poses with hub 2 / hub 3 / link 2 tops inside the skin: 25.05 -> 25.59) + the J4 spring coil as hub 4 at r 12 everywhere (fit, underside, K6; 25.59 -> 26.71); near-touch over all faces 32.53 (min metal 0.40 mm). Stops at margin 10: 25.47; at margin 5: 62.70. Closure exact (<= 3e-6 deg), 0 stop-window violations, hub F 49 / 59 / 66 / 77 mm. Knee arc by history (slerped path from rest, no snap between arcs): 24 ws poses end on the other arc, the number is unchanged (25.05 / 25.59); pessimistic bound (a ws pose counts only if taken on BOTH arcs): 42.26 (54 of 277 ws poses lost). Champion same bench (osn verifier champbig_frozen, farm, re-run now): 64.93 (near1 67.54). Not refuted on the number; 4 ACTIVE DOF (J4 must be sensed: the two-arc hysteresis means J1-J3 do not determine it), so it fails R5-aim / the round's 3-active rule and its lead over the pin-knee 3R (27.20 at margin 5) shrinks to ~0.5 point under these checks

exact_frozen.protocol: fit Bench(60,160) fast, worn Bench(110,360) exact, K6 1 mm

mechanism.notes: spherical 4R, open chain (GH closes it). bodies: link 1, link 2, link 3, member 4 (J4 arm-end plate + K7 neck to BOTTOM). joints: J1-J4 O20 v5 hubs (MR117-2RS pairs). spring: preloaded return-to-centre torsion spring on J4 (music wire 0.95, D 22, 6 coils, preload 40 N.mm, 19 N.mm/rad). J2 stops: O2 dowel in a slot of link 2's end plate (part of an existing made part). custom: base, 3 links, member 4, 4 hub shafts, dowel (est.); catalogue: 4 x MR117 pair + spring (est.). Alternative reading (J4 a sprung, sensed passive pin, 3 active): active_dof 3, passive_rot 1, sensed_passive 1 -> 13.25.
